title: Chapter 13 Calculation of Your Disposable Income
notes: The § 1325(b)(2)-(3) calculation (issue #365): lines 5-38 are the same means-test engine lines B122A-2 prints (core/means_test.py, the form's own 'line numbers 1-4 are not used'), lines 39-45 its Chapter 13 branch, the entered lines come from the case's means_test_input, and the statutory figure the 04/25 revision prints ($214.58 per child on line 29) is a code/dollar-amounts figure. Known defects, verified by widget geometry: nearly every amount box is named undefined_NN and the geometry is the identity; every right-margin 'Copy here' box shares the widget of the box it copies (one value, two printed boxes, always agreeing), as do 33a/33b (9b's and 13b's totals), line 38's three copy boxes (lines 24, 32, 37) and line 42 (line 38); line 33c's copy box is wired to 13e's FIRST ROW amount instead of its total (vehicle_2_loan_rows says how the projection compensates); line 34's third monthly box is named '60'; and line 11's export states are the line numbers each answer sends you to.
